notes: WCS0 (itaconate-producing parent) is the reference/control at each of three phases; ALE strains are evolved_isolate (shared 31-kb deletion stated only for the study, so no perturbed_genes per sample). Medium is M9 acetate + glutamate + yeast extract -> minimal_plus_hydrolysate, carbon organic_acid. Temperature and aeration not given. No inducer mentioned.
